readme.markdown:
# Dashform MCP Server

Connect AI assistants to [Dashform](https://getaiform.com) — build and manage AI-powered forms, funnels, quizzes, and lead qualification workflows through the Model Context Protocol.


## Features

- **Form Management** — Create, read, update, and delete forms and AI funnels programmatically
- **Reply Collection** — Submit and retrieve form responses
- **AI Lead Qualification** — Use built-in AI to check if a lead is a good fit for a business
- **Service Marketplace** — Search merchants, services, and categories
- **Booking** — Check availability and book appointments through AI agents
- **OAuth 2.1** — Secure authentication with dynamic client registration

## Quickstart

Dashform MCP is a hosted remote server. No local installation is required — just add the endpoint URL to your MCP client.

**Endpoint:** `https://getaiform.com/api/mcp`

**Transport:** Streamable HTTP

**Authentication:** OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (RFC 7591)

### Claude Desktop

Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dashform": {
      "url": "https://getaiform.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Desktop will handle OAuth authorization automatically.

### Cursor

Add to your Cursor MCP settings (`.cursor/mcp.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dashform": {
      "url": "https://getaiform.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### VS Code / GitHub Copilot

Add to your VS Code settings (`.vscode/mcp.json`):

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "dashform": {
      "url": "https://getaiform.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Windsurf

Add to your `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dashform": {
      "serverUrl": "https://getaiform.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### MCP Inspector

```bash
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --url https://getaiform.com/api/mcp
```

## Tools

### Form Management (requires authentication)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get_user_info` | Get current user profile (userId, organizationId, name, email) |
| `list_organizations` | List all organizations for a user |
| `list_forms` | List all forms in an organization with reply counts |
| `get_form` | Get full form details including config, questions, and theme |
| `create_form` | Create a new form (structured or dynamic AI type) |
| `update_form` | Update form config, questions, endings, or theme |
| `delete_form` | Permanently delete a form and all its data |
| `create_reply` | Submit a new reply/response to a form |

### Marketplace Discovery (no authentication required)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `list_categories` | List marketplace service categories with merchant counts |
| `search_merchants` | Search merchants by keyword, category, or location |
| `search_services` | Search services across all merchants with price filtering |

### Agent Booking (no authentication required)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get_business_info` | Get business profile for a published funnel |
| `get_services` | List available services for a funnel |
| `get_form_questions` | Get question schema (keys, types, options) for a funnel |
| `check_fit` | AI-powered lead qualification — checks if a lead matches the business criteria |
| `get_availability` | Get booking availability and scheduling link |
| `book_appointment` | Submit a lead record and book an appointment |

## Authentication

Dashform MCP uses **OAuth 2.1** with the Authorization Code flow and supports **dynamic client registration** (RFC 7591). This means MCP clients like Claude Desktop and Cursor can automatically register and authenticate without manual API key setup.

### OAuth Endpoints

| Endpoint | URL |
|----------|-----|
| Authorization | `https://getaiform.com/oauth/authorize` |
| Token | `https://getaiform.com/api/auth/oauth2/token` |
| Client Registration | `https://getaiform.com/api/auth/oauth2/register` |
| Resource Metadata | `https://getaiform.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` |
| MCP Discovery | `https://getaiform.com/.well-known/mcp.json` |

### Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `openid` | OpenID Connect identity |
| `profile` | User profile information |
| `email` | User email address |
| `read:forms` | Read forms and form data |
| `write:forms` | Create and update forms |
| `read:submissions` | Read form submissions |
| `write:submissions` | Create form submissions |
| `read:webhooks` | Read webhook configurations |
| `offline_access` | Refresh token for long-lived sessions |

## MCP Discovery

The server exposes a discovery endpoint at `/.well-known/mcp.json` that returns the server manifest, including all available tools and the endpoint URL.

```bash
curl https://getaiform.com/.well-known/mcp.json
```

## Use Cases

- **Build forms with natural language** — "Create a customer feedback form with a rating scale and open-ended questions"
- **Manage forms at scale** — List, update, or delete forms across organizations
- **Collect responses** — Submit test data or integrate with automated pipelines
- **AI-powered lead qualification** — "Check if this lead is a good fit for my consulting business"
- **Service discovery** — "Find yoga studios in San Francisco that offer private sessions"
- **Appointment booking** — "Book a free consultation with the nearest available therapist"

## Support

- Email: support@getaiform.com
- Website: [getaiform.com](https://getaiform.com)
- Issues: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/makloai/mcp-server-dashform/issues)

toolsPreview.name: get_user_info
toolsPreview.description: Get the authenticated user's ID, email, name, and the active organization MCP is acting on. Identity comes from the OAuth token — no parameters needed.

toolsPreview.name: list_organizations
toolsPreview.description: List all organizations the authenticated user belongs to, with their role in each. Use switch_active_org to change which one MCP acts on.

toolsPreview.name: switch_active_org
toolsPreview.description: Set which organization MCP acts on for subsequent tool calls. The selection is verified against your memberships and persists for this connection.

toolsPreview.name: list_forms
toolsPreview.description: List forms in the active organization, with status and share/edit URLs. Supports search, sort, and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: get_form
toolsPreview.description: Get a form by ID in the authoring vocabulary — the same shape update_form accepts, so a result can be edited and sent straight back. Unset attributes are omitted.

toolsPreview.name: create_form
toolsPreview.description: Create a complete form in one call — name, steps, theme and settings together. 'structured' is a Logic Funnel (default), 'dynamic' is an AI Funnel. Start and end screens are added automatically unless you supply your own. Call publish_form afterwards to take it live.

toolsPreview.name: update_form
toolsPreview.description: Update a form. Include only what you want to change under `form` — everything else is left untouched, including nested objects: sending one theme colour leaves the other theme settings alone. Steps are merged by key by default, so editing one question needs only that step; pass stepsMode 'replace' to send a complete new list.

toolsPreview.name: delete_form
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a form and all its versions and replies. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: create_reply
toolsPreview.description: Create a reply on the form's latest published version. Optionally seed respondent info and answers (question key -> value).

toolsPreview.name: publish_form
toolsPreview.description: Publish the form's current draft as a new live version. Required before a form can receive replies.

toolsPreview.name: get_form_version
toolsPreview.description: Get a specific form version by its version ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_published_form_version
toolsPreview.description: Get the latest published version of a form (the live snapshot respondents see).

toolsPreview.name: suggest_scoring_criteria
toolsPreview.description: AI-generate suggested hot/warm/cold lead-scoring criteria for a form.

toolsPreview.name: update_scoring_criteria
toolsPreview.description: Set a form's hot/warm/cold lead-scoring criteria. Returns the updated form.

toolsPreview.name: list_replies
toolsPreview.description: List replies for a form (paginated). Returns respondent data, status, and scoring verdict.

toolsPreview.name: get_reply
toolsPreview.description: Get a single reply by ID, including answers and scoring.

toolsPreview.name: delete_reply
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a single reply. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: batch_delete_replies
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete up to 100 replies of a form. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: override_verdict
toolsPreview.description: Manually set or reset a reply's lead verdict (hot/warm/cold). Returns the updated reply.

toolsPreview.name: rescore_form_replies
toolsPreview.description: Re-run AI lead scoring across a form's replies. Returns the number marked for scoring.

toolsPreview.name: mark_actioned
toolsPreview.description: Mark a reply as actioned (followed up on).

toolsPreview.name: get_form_scoring_state
toolsPreview.description: Get a form's lead-scoring state: pending hot-lead count, whether criteria are active, and last criteria update.

toolsPreview.name: list_organization_hot_lead_counts
toolsPreview.description: List per-form hot-lead counts across the active organization.

toolsPreview.name: get_replies_insights
toolsPreview.description: Get aggregate insights for a form's replies over a time range (completion, drop-off, answer distributions).

toolsPreview.name: analytics_chat
toolsPreview.description: Ask a natural-language question about a form's replies. Returns the assistant's final answer (single-shot; the analytics agent may query the data to respond).

toolsPreview.name: list_zapier_hooks
toolsPreview.description: List Zapier webhook subscriptions for a form.

toolsPreview.name: toggle_zapier_hook
toolsPreview.description: Activate or pause a Zapier webhook subscription.

toolsPreview.name: delete_zapier_hook
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a Zapier webhook subscription. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: list_connections
toolsPreview.description: List integration connections (webhook, Slack, HubSpot, etc.) in the active organization. Optionally filter by provider.

toolsPreview.name: get_connection
toolsPreview.description: Get a single connection by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_webhook_connection
toolsPreview.description: Create a webhook or Discord connection (no OAuth). For Slack/HubSpot/Mailchimp/etc., connect via the dashboard's OAuth flow first.

toolsPreview.name: revoke_connection
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a connection (stops future deliveries). Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_connection
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a connection and its integrations. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: reconnect_quota_precheck
toolsPreview.description: Check the backfill backlog for a connection before reconnecting it.

toolsPreview.name: list_integrations
toolsPreview.description: List integrations configured on a form.

toolsPreview.name: get_integration
toolsPreview.description: Get a single integration by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_integration
toolsPreview.description: Create a spreadsheet-style integration (Google Sheets/Airtable/Notion) on a form, mapping form answers to columns.

toolsPreview.name: create_integration_from_config
toolsPreview.description: Create a message-style integration (Webhook/Discord/Slack/HubSpot/Mailchimp) on a form from a full action config.

toolsPreview.name: delete_integration
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete an integration from a form. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: toggle_integration
toolsPreview.description: Activate or pause an integration. Returns the updated integration.

toolsPreview.name: list_integration_events
toolsPreview.description: List recent delivery events for an integration.

toolsPreview.name: replay_integration_event
toolsPreview.description: Re-enqueue a failed or past integration delivery event.

toolsPreview.name: list_airtable_bases
toolsPreview.description: List Airtable bases available to a connection.

toolsPreview.name: list_slack_channels
toolsPreview.description: List Slack channels available to a connection.

toolsPreview.name: list_hubspot_contact_properties
toolsPreview.description: List HubSpot contact properties available to a connection.

toolsPreview.name: list_mailchimp_audiences
toolsPreview.description: List Mailchimp audiences available to a connection.

toolsPreview.name: get_org_branding
toolsPreview.description: Get the active organization's white-label branding (logo, favicon, brand color).

toolsPreview.name: update_org_branding
toolsPreview.description: Update the active org's white-label branding. Owner/admin only. Returns the updated branding.

toolsPreview.name: get_org_email_config
toolsPreview.description: Get the active org's white-label email config (sender name, reply-to).

toolsPreview.name: update_org_email_config
toolsPreview.description: Update the active org's white-label email config. Owner/admin only.

toolsPreview.name: list_custom_domains
toolsPreview.description: List the active organization's custom domains and their status.

toolsPreview.name: add_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Add a custom domain to the active org (returns DNS instructions). Owner/admin only.

toolsPreview.name: verify_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Re-check a custom domain's DNS/verification and promote it to active when healthy. Owner/admin only.

toolsPreview.name: remove_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Remove a custom domain from the active org. Owner/admin only. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: set_custom_domain_default_form
toolsPreview.description: Pin (or clear, with null) the default form a custom domain serves at its root. Owner/admin only.

toolsPreview.name: get_ai_provider_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the active org's BYOK (bring-your-own-key) AI provider status. Owner only.

toolsPreview.name: save_ai_provider_key
toolsPreview.description: Set the active org's BYOK AI provider key (validated before saving). Owner only. The key is never returned.

toolsPreview.name: remove_ai_provider_key
toolsPreview.description: Remove the active org's BYOK AI provider key. Owner only. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: get_quiz_credits_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the acting user's quiz-credits balance and status.

toolsPreview.name: create_quiz_credits_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create a checkout session to purchase quiz credits. Returns a checkout URL. Requires a verified email.

toolsPreview.name: search_photos
toolsPreview.description: Search Pexels for background photos (welcome/end screens, questions).

toolsPreview.name: search_videos
toolsPreview.description: Search Pexels for background videos (welcome/end screens, questions).

toolsPreview.name: refine_prompt
toolsPreview.description: AI-refine a form-building prompt for the given funnel type. Returns the refined prompt text (single-shot).

toolsPreview.name: transcribe
toolsPreview.description: Transcribe base64-encoded audio to text.

toolsPreview.name: upload_blob
toolsPreview.description: Upload a file (base64) to blob storage for use in forms. Returns the blob URL.

toolsPreview.name: delete_blob
toolsPreview.description: Delete a blob by its URL. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: import_agent_profile
toolsPreview.description: Extract a business/agent profile from a website URL (for marketplace discovery). Returns the extracted profile; use update_form to persist it.

toolsPreview.name: get_chat
toolsPreview.description: Get a chat (e.g. a form-editor conversation) by its reference ID.

toolsPreview.name: load_messages
toolsPreview.description: Load the messages of a chat by its reference ID.

toolsPreview.name: clear_messages
toolsPreview.description: Clear all messages in a chat by its reference ID. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_chat
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a chat by ID. Pass confirm: true to proceed.

toolsPreview.name: chat_form_editor
toolsPreview.description: Conversationally edit a form. Provide the form id and the conversation; the assistant reads the form, applies edits (persisted), and returns its summary plus the updated form.

toolsPreview.name: run_ax_audit
toolsPreview.description: Run an Agent Experience (AX) audit on a website: fetch the page and score how ready it is for AI agents and crawlers across 10 dimensions (crawlability, structured data, actionability, agent interaction, discoverability, content quality, performance, authoritativeness, freshness, security). Returns an axScore (0-100), a grade, per-dimension scores, and specific issues with concrete fixes. The URL must be a public https site.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all available service categories on the Dashform marketplace with merchant counts. Use this to understand what types of services are available before searching.

toolsPreview.name: search_merchants
toolsPreview.description: Search for businesses and service providers on the Dashform marketplace. Filter by category, location, or keyword. Each result includes a funnel_id you can use with get_business_info, get_services, check_fit, and book_appointment.

toolsPreview.name: search_services
toolsPreview.description: Search for specific services across all marketplace merchants. Find services by name, category, price range, or location. Each result includes the provider funnel_id for booking.

toolsPreview.name: get_business_info
toolsPreview.description: Get business information for a Dashform funnel, including description, industry, location, services, and booking link. Use this to understand what a business offers before checking lead fit.

toolsPreview.name: get_services
toolsPreview.description: Get the list of services or products offered by a business through this funnel. Optionally filter by category.

toolsPreview.name: get_form_questions
toolsPreview.description: Get the list of questions for this funnel. Returns question keys, types, descriptions, and options. Call this BEFORE check_fit or book_appointment to understand what information to collect from leads.

toolsPreview.name: check_fit
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate lead fit against this business. Provide answers keyed by question keys from get_form_questions. Returns a score (0-100), fit assessment, confidence level, reasoning, and recommended next action. Also accepts legacy lead object for backwards compatibility.

toolsPreview.name: get_availability
toolsPreview.description: Get booking availability for this business. Returns a booking link (e.g. Calendly) if configured, or a message about how to schedule.

toolsPreview.name: book_appointment
toolsPreview.description: Submit a lead's information to request an appointment. Provide answers keyed by question keys from get_form_questions. Creates a reply record visible in the dashboard and triggers connected integrations (CRM, email, webhooks). Also accepts legacy lead object for backwards compatibility.
